source: If your config has no {0}, the preset uses {1}, {2} and {3}. The {4} format reads and writes these files. All {5} files of a locale share one set of keys, as in a Fluent bundle.
text: 如果你的設定中沒有 {0}，預設集會使用 {1}、{2} 和 {3}。{4} 格式會讀取並寫入這些檔案。同一個語系的所有 {5} 檔案共用同一組鍵，就像 Fluent bundle 一樣。
